t: Empire State Building Goes Gold for Voyager

img.cap: The Empire State Building towers above other surrounding buildings. The upper part of the Empire State Building is lit up in gold. Light beams cut through the hazy night sky.

p: is seen illuminated in gold to celebrate NASA’s

spacecraft as it was about to pass one light-day away from Earth, a distance reached by no other human-made object, Nov. 17, 2026. The color gold represents the gold-plated copper phonograph record that is flying on Voyager; the
